bound_semantics.input_output: Bound before dispatch/decode and while parent streams pipes; no communicate() unbounded capture.
bound_semantics.memory: No OS memory/data/address-space limit claimed. Host refused both RLIMIT_AS and RLIMIT_DATA candidates, preserved as failures. Fixed parent ps RSS samples plus trusted child getrusage highwater refusal;128MiB threshold, sampling gaps/native allocations between checks not prevented.
bound_semantics.parent_death: No supervision after parent death promised.
bound_semantics.rss: Parent fixed /bin/ps exact-owned-child RSS samples and trusted child getrusage highwater,128MiB threshold. Sampling gaps/startup/parent death and hostile-host replacement excluded; no continuous/hardRSS claim.
bound_semantics.wall: Parent-owned monotonic deadline, process-group kill/reap; no retries.

cleanup_policy.limit: Direct child fallback does not establish descendant containment. Trusted fixed backend refuses spawning; parent death/hostile host excluded.
